Strategy: Shift the item-scaled band edges to thirty-to-forty-five, keeping the half-item reward and penalty. It may help if the higher window suits larger items, but may fail if the lower edge matters more.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
